root_cause.text: The smc_msg_event tracepoint unconditionally dereferences smc->conn.lnk->ibname without checking if conn->lnk is NULL, which is NULL for SMC-D connections, causing a NULL pointer dereference.
root_cause.evidence: The commit description states "conn->lnk is only set for SMC-R; for SMC-D it is NULL" and the tracepoint definition `__string(name, smc->conn.lnk->ibname)` directly dereferences a potentially NULL pointer. The patch adds a ternary check `smc->conn.lnk ? smc->conn.lnk->ibname : ""` to prevent this.

Author: Tony Lu <tonylu@linux.alibaba.com>
Date:   Mon Nov 1 15:39:14 2021 +0800

    net/smc: Introduce tracepoints for tx and rx msg
    
    This introduce two tracepoints for smc tx and rx msg to help us
    diagnosis issues of data path. These two tracepoitns don't cover the
    path of CORK or MSG_MORE in tx, just the top half of data path.
    
    Signed-off-by: Tony Lu <tonylu@linux.alibaba.com>

bic_trace_step.reason: The tracepoint definition smc_msg_event in TP_STRUCT__entry and TP_fast_assign directly dereferences smc->conn.lnk->ibname without checking if conn->lnk is NULL. Since conn->lnk is NULL for SMC-D connections, this causes a NULL pointer dereference. No NULL check is present, so the bug is introduced.
